BERT4Rec’s masked-item recovery uses bidirectional context; it does not directly measure next-item generalization. The original paper identifies target visibility as making bidirectional next-item training trivial and introduces Cloze masking to prevent it. Separate diagnostics into random masked-token recovery, training-exposed prefix completion, and held-out next-item ranking with an appended reserved mask. Prefix recovery measures fit to exposed examples, not generalization. [BERT4Rec](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.06690)

Sampled ranking metrics can reverse model comparisons relative to full-catalog ranking, even in expectation; repeated sampling addresses variability but does not eliminate this bias. RecSys 2025 research further examines sampling reliability through resolution, fidelity, robustness and predictive power. Keep the host’s 99-negative, seed-42 validation HR@10 unchanged for selection. Proposed auxiliary probes: vary candidate counts, sampling seeds and uniform versus popularity-based negatives on training-prefix examples; report these separately. Estimate selection uncertainty with paired user bootstraps within each category, then average the four category scores equally. Bootstrap intervals quantify user-sampling uncertainty conditional on the fixed candidates. [Sampled-metric analysis](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/), [2025 sampling study](https://doi.org/10.1145/3705328.3748086)

Proposed fault-injection checks: deliberately expose the target, substitute count−1 for the final nonpadding readout, and remove the appended mask; verify that structural assertions detect each corruption. Include short left-padded histories and full-length truncation cases. Require candidate permutation to preserve item-associated scores; padding invariance requires preserving effective position IDs. Develop these checks using training prefixes. Temporal leakage is a separate concern: 2025 research documents inflated sequential-recommendation results from overlapping training/evaluation periods; record this limitation while preserving the supplied splits. [Leakage study](https://researchportal.helsinki.fi/en/publications/dont-get-ahead-of-yourself-a-critical-study-on-data-leakage-in-of/)
